about_the_game:
Journey to Seek Light - Demo Now Available

‌
You will embody a hero pursuing light in a lightless world, taking on enemies through card battles. The game combines RPG randomness with three elemental attributes, creating rich tactical depth. Choose optimal strategies against different foes, grow stronger, and uncover the world’s truth.

‌5 BOSSES:

‌
The demo features 5 boss enemies, each with three unique cards and battle tactics. To succeed, tailor your deck to their traits and rely on a dash of luck.

‌20+ Powerful Cards:

‌
The demo includes over 20 cards. Collect them by defeating enemies and build your ultimate deck. Flexibly combine cards of varying attributes based on enemy weaknesses and deck synergy. Your strategic options will expand as you progress.

‌2-Player Online Battles:

‌
The demo has a simple online mode unlocked after defeating the third boss. Test your deck in multiplayer showdowns!
